factors.value_notes: IUCN reports a broad 8–17 °C preference; a Florida east-coast study observed burrow habitat at 8.6–15.4 °C and depths of 150–290 m. This supports deep bottom-habitat thermal context, not a satellite-SST preference curve; the configured 8–18 °C / 10–15 °C band remains only partly supported as an SST gate.
